title: PhonaCore-ASLP acoustic measurement validation
reference: Praat, using a prespecified analysis protocol
primaryQuestion: Can PhonaCore measurements agree with the predefined reference procedure for selected acoustic parameters?
blinding: Reference analysis should be performed without changing settings based on PhonaCore results.
dataRule: Participant identifiers must be pseudonymized in the research dataset.
exclusions: Predefined acquisition/quality exclusions only; exclusions must be logged.
